title: redactFailure redacts detail values but not keys, so a revealed credential used as a key leaks
resolution: redactFailure redacts keys with the same function and joins the values of keys that become equal in order; contract section 7.4 and the requirement Run redaction by credential value; tests that failed before the fix

title: Sequential split and join replacement breaks overlapping occurrences, redacts inside markers, grows the output, and hides a touched shape secret's suffix
resolution: Occurrences are found in the original text, merged when they overlap or touch, and replaced by one marker each; a word where they touch a shape secret is redacted whole; regression tests for each case that failed before the fix

title: An adopted execution must request the credential again but cannot hold a valid launch authorization after its grant expires
resolution: Contract section 7.3 defines the re-delivery ownership check and its refusals with the launch authorization reasons; requirement Re-delivery to an adopted execution with an adoption-after-expiry scenario; item 12 and 18 tests in section 9

title: A rotation can replace the token, so a re-delivery after adoption reveals a value other than the one the running harness uses
resolution: Section 8.1 refuses a rotation with conflict unless the slot is revoked and unreserved; a revocation is never blocked and cancels the slot's attempts; a removal drains or rejects them per ADR 0005 decision 6 (coordinator-confirmed, b00cdde8)

title: The device-login refusal contradicts the unchanged harness-account-pools requirement that accepts any declared subscription mechanism
resolution: A harness-account-pools delta modifies Subscription account slots to accept only a deliverable mechanism, by D6 subscription-token, with a scenario for a declared device-login slot

title: The requirement lets the device-login restriction lapse when a later item defines a format, while the contract revisits it only if item 35 overturns D6
resolution: Subscription token delivery only now ties the restriction to item 35 overturning D6, as the contract and design do

title: The L9 evidence says no file imported REDACTED from scheduling at the base and counts the packages wrongly
resolution: The record names the scheduling account pool test as the one importer and its migration, names the four private packages, and records a reproducible multiline import check and the root package's bin-only publication

title: The make verify task is unticked although the record shows it passing
resolution: Task 3.2 is ticked with its revision bf7c0335, and the re-run after the pass 1 fixes is task 3.4, ticked with its revision b00cdde8

title: A reinstatement or removal between the rotation's check and its store lets a run see the old token or leaves a live credential in a tombstone
resolution: Credentials are versioned: the rotation stores a new version and switches the slot record by compare-and-set only while revoked and unreserved; destroy removes every version and any later store; conformance cases

title: Run text is redacted only when it leaves the host, while worker logs and the outbox must never hold the credential, and a refused run's text has no defined end
resolution: Section 7.4 redacts before every worker record and before the host's exit; after a refused re-delivery the worker discards the run's text and keeps only facts without it; item 18 test updated

title: A credential split across stream chunks or cut by truncation is not found by a redaction of one text
resolution: Section 7.4 requires a sliding window holding back the trailing word and at least max(len) - 1 characters, and truncation only after redaction; an item 18 test and a scenario for a split token

title: The re-delivery requirement omits the quarantine, epoch, worker, and mechanism checks that the contract makes
resolution: The requirement names every launch authorization check a started execution still passes, the reservation and slot checks, and the admitted delivery check, with a quarantine scenario

title: Revocation says its reservation is released only with the terminal fact, while capacity reservation section 6 releases at once when no execution is authorized or started
resolution: Section 8.1 and the requirement release as capacity reservation section 6 says, with the cancellation as the justifying fact; a scenario and an item 12 test for a reserved attempt not yet launched

title: The device-login refusal applies to every harness, wider than D6 for Claude Code, and its only revisit trigger is item 35
resolution: Coordinator decision: add-slot and delivery refuse a mechanism without a delivery admitted for the slot's harness; by D6 Claude Code has only subscription-token; D6 and item 35 stay a remaining gate; no ADR edit

title: A code comment and the design claim that no shape secret holds whitespace, but the creds block rule spans lines
resolution: The comment and design decision 3 name the creds block as the exception whose parts match on their own; no behavior changes

title: The contract says a shape secret that an occurrence touches, while the code redacts any word that holds both
resolution: Contract, requirement, scenario, and design say that a whitespace-free word holding both an occurrence and a shape secret is replaced whole

title: The run redaction list leaves out the interactive terminal stream
resolution: Section 7.4 and the requirement cover every text of the run, whatever its channel, the terminal stream included; item 18 tests name it

title: The delivery channel is not named, so a broker message could keep the credential at rest
resolution: Section 7 and the transport requirement deliver only in the control plane's API response, never in a broker message or stream

title: The word unless in the harness-account-pools delta reads as an automatic lapse of the device-login refusal
resolution: The requirement now states the admitted delivery per harness without a lapse condition, by D6 subscription-token for Claude Code

title: A requirement sentence that the restriction is revisited only if item 35 overturns D6 is a process obligation no test can check
resolution: Removed from the requirement; the revisit is in design decision 1 and the verification remaining gates

title: A scenario accepts either attempt-not-launchable or execution-conflict for a refused re-delivery
resolution: Section 7.3 states the check order; the scenario is split into a cancelled attempt with attempt-not-launchable and a revoked grant with execution-conflict

title: The living scenario Slot revoked during a session still allows draining, while revocation now always cancels
resolution: The delta modifies Session affinity with its whole text, and the scenario says the session is cancelled

title: Pass 1 records 4 and 8 have stale resolutions, and records 7 and 8 have no commit
resolution: Records 4 and 8 describe the removal correction and task 3.4, and records 7 and 8 name b0bf842e

title: The verification revision list names the removal correction by position and leaves out the make verify record
resolution: The revision list and the removal correction checks name b00cdde8, and e496533c is listed
